title: Keep part of the daily email limit for reminders and replies so a campaign cannot use it all

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (project thread: Check every email and message system)

detail:
Production evidence 2026-11-18: the Founding Member campaign (557 recipients) drained about 200 jobs at the start of each UTC day (198 on 11-17 14:30Z, 201 on 11-18 00:00Z), which is the whole Resend daily quota (Resend answered 429 daily_quota_exceeded right after). Every one-to-one email later that day was accepted by the API and then failed asynchronously with reached_daily_quota: event reminders (Tomorrow/Soon at The Group, Royal Temple), the Vera owner brief and a Message Member send to a member, 25 lost since 11-12. The outbox lane trip only fires on a synchronous refusal, so these jobs were marked done. Fix: when EMAIL_DAILY_SEND_LIMIT is set, the drain counts bulk email jobs finished since UTC midnight and parks further bulk email until the next midnight once it reaches the limit minus a reserve (a quarter of the limit, at least 20), without spending an attempt. An unreadable count holds bulk rather than spending the reserve. No limit set keeps the old behaviour.

DONE 2026-11-18: lib/queue/outbox.ts bulkDailyBudget + the park before the provider call; EMAIL_DAILY_SEND_LIMIT set to 200 in Vercel Production so bulk stops at 150 a day.

verify.note: Passes while bulk email is parked before the provider call once the bulk share of the daily limit is spent.
